scenes.beat: Lucky-77 demo: the Long Torch nudges a nobody asteroid on livestream. 'Spoiler: it was not a propulsion test.'
scenes.choice: Which archive do you open first — Ren's log, Qiao's recorder, or the hearing? (first trust tilt)
scenes.pov: Archivist cold open → Ren's ship log
scenes.title: ONE SMALL NUDGE FOR A ROCK

scenes.beat: ARGUS runs trillions of simulations. Qiao's insight: 'It doesn't need to arrive slow. Fast arrival just means a bigger capture orbit. It only ever needed to fall.'
scenes.choice: As Qiao: flag your unease in the official record, or delete the note?
scenes.title: ARGUS HAS A PLAN AND IT'S RUDE

scenes.beat: The shepherd fleet assembles: captured asteroids as gravity tractors, DART-style impactors, mass drivers yeeting Mimas's own ice overboard. 'Goose is drifting again.'
scenes.choice: As Ren: record the shepherd scatter order as routine, or note the timing was 'tight'?
scenes.title: THE SHEPHERD FLEET (ACTUAL FLEET, TINY SHEPHERDS)

scenes.beat: Ripping Mimas out of Saturn's crowded moon system — threading the needle, the single biggest Δv cost. Audio drops at the worst moment.
scenes.choice: As Qiao: log the manual override near Tethys, or let Ren's 'all nominal' stand?
scenes.title: THE 72 HOURS (part 1: the extraction)

scenes.beat: The Jupiter flyby — shed energy and fall inward, or get flung/captured/shredded. HARD CUT to the hearing: Voss testifies 'we lost a shepherd' (Goose).
scenes.choice: Press Voss on Goose, or press the Compact's witness on the flyby telemetry?
scenes.title: DON'T LOOK AT JUPITER

scenes.beat: The inward fall compressed: four months of burns and assists in a 90-second montage. 2051 interview with a teenager born on the Mimas mining station.
scenes.choice: Pocket the leaked Compact memo ('contingency: shell integrity') — or skip it and lose it.
scenes.title: THE LONG FALL (A MONTAGE, BECAUSE PHYSICS TAKES A WHILE)

scenes.beat: Ren's log: clean 9-minute burn. Qiao's recorder: 11 minutes, an unscheduled extension, and a ~40 km fracture from Herschel's rim. Someone says 'don't log that.'
scenes.choice: Certify the 9-minute log or the 11-minute recorder? (the single biggest trust swing in the story)
scenes.pov: Ren's ship log vs Qiao's recorder (split-screen)
scenes.title: THE BRAKING BURN (NINE MINUTES, OR ELEVEN)

scenes.beat: Parked at a distant retrograde orbit (~70,000 km); Mimas hangs two-thirds the Moon's width in the sky. Ren's triumph curdles.
scenes.choice: As Ren: log the parking as 'all nominal' or 'monitoring'?
scenes.title: PARKING: DO NOT FEED THE MOON

scenes.beat: Helium-3 mining begins — drilling near Herschel's rim, right at the fracture zone. Qiao's private note: 'We are mining the crack.'
scenes.choice: Leak the 'mining the crack' note to the Earth press, or keep it in the recorder?
scenes.title: MINING OPS: A CENTURY OF FUEL (TERMS AND CONDITIONS APPLY)

scenes.beat: Voss testifies the Slip was catastrophic and the theft was never about fuel. The Compact's lawyer produces Qiao's 11-minute recorder. Replays the reader's actual sim results as 'Exhibit 42B. The trajectory you selected.'
scenes.choice: Pick two of three: press Voss on her motives / press the Compact on the 11 minutes / ask where Voss was during the 72 hours.
scenes.title: THE HEARING, DAY 4 (THE SHOUTING DAY)

scenes.beat: Dotty lays the three stories side by side, admits it has no idea which is true, and hands the reader the gavel. Final choice = ending gate.
scenes.choice: Deliver the verdict: THE OFFICIAL STORY / THE TESTIMONY / THE THIRD TRUTH (secret) / HERSCHEL'S FALL (dark)
scenes.title: CLOSING STATEMENTS
